subtitle.en: Two handles. One load. Move together.
subtitle.zh: 两个把手，同一载荷，同步移动。

description.en: Two robots carry a tray between supports. Each provider finds its own joint path; the app waits for both grips before lifting and synchronizes the motion so the tray stays level. Choose matching arms or mix manufacturers.
description.zh: 两台机器人在支架之间搬运托盘。各自的 Provider 求解关节路径；应用确认两侧都已夹稳才抬起，并同步运动以保持托盘水平。可以使用相同机械臂，也可以混合机型。

label.zh: 控制两台机械臂与夹爪

label.en: Coordinate the shared load and work area
label.zh: 协调共同载荷与工作区域

origin.en: Two robot instances, one MuJoCo world. Contact grips and a shared motion barrier; no hardware connection.
origin.zh: 两台机器人位于同一个 MuJoCo 世界。通过接触夹持和共同运动屏障协作，不连接硬件。

description.en: Confirm both grips, lift together, and set the tray on the other support.
description.zh: 确认两侧夹持，同步抬起，再将托盘放到另一支架。

description.en: Start at the other support and run the same shared-load app in reverse.
description.zh: 从另一支架开始，反向执行同一协作搬运任务。
